# Test fixtures

- `sample.mp4` is generated by `scripts/make-test-video.swift` (H.264, 320×180,
  2 seconds). It is original test material created for this repository.
- `rar5_stored.rar` and `rar5_many.rar` come from the
  [libarchive test suite](https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/tree/master/libarchive/test)
  (files `test_read_format_rar5_stored.rar.uu` and
  `test_read_format_rar5_stored_manyfiles.rar.uu`). They are used only to
  exercise RAR 5 inspection and extraction through `/usr/bin/bsdtar`.

  <https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/blob/master/COPYING>.
